_comment: MOCK ONLY (MOCK=1). Overrides applied on top of the real discovery snapshot so the demo shows editable terminals, lock reasons and non-OP states. Gate fields follow pytmc: editable when DISP == 0 and DISA != DISV; default is DISP=DISA=DISV=1 (locked). state_flags/link_flags override the raw flag bits behind StateRaw/LinkCode (1020 gets an illustrative ERROR flag). 1004 reproduces the link condition seen on the live PLC on 2026-11-03 (ADDITIONAL_LINK on port D, Link_RBV MULTIPLE_FLAGS); it comes and goes, so it is pinned here.
